## About
Certified Alignments is a small automotive business in Temple Hills, MD. We set it up to quickly and specifically take care of your vehicle's alignment, front-end suspension and other ride-related needs.
We align on state-of-the-art Hunter equipment, and we also handle brakes, shocks and struts, ball joints and tie-rods, C.V. drive axles, and tire mounting and balancing.
One reviewer came in because their mechanic sent them, and another came on a referral from a satisfied customer. For the fastest service, give us a call for an appointment.

## Services
- Latest Technology 4-Wheel Alignments: Alignments on Hunter equipment for cars, light trucks and custom wheels.
- Brakes: Labor to install front pads, rear pads, rotors and pads, or rear shoes.
- Tie-rods: Replacement of worn tie-rods and other front-end parts.
- Shocks & Struts: Shocks and struts replaced so your car rides right again.
- C.V. Drive Axles: C.V. drive axle replacement.
- Tires / Mounting / Balancing: Tire mounting and balancing, on or off the vehicle.
- Parts inspection only: A look at your front-end parts when you just want to know where things stand. (From $30)

## FAQ
Q: How much is an alignment?
A: Most cars, SUV's and light trucks are between $95 to $120. Some camber and caster adjustments, heat, bushings or shims cost extra, and so do custom wheels and lifted, lowered or modified vehicles.

Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: For the fastest service, please call us for an appointment.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 10 to 5. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Can you align custom wheels?
A: Yes, we align custom wheels up to 30 inches. Custom wheels and lifted, lowered or modified vehicles come at additional cost.
